title: An explicit section of the Laudenbach-type exact sequence of the big mapping class group of $M_Γ$
summary: Given a locally finite graph $Γ$, Udall proved that the mapping class group of the doubled handlebody associated to $Γ$ is an extension of the mapping class group of $Γ$ by a possibly infinite direct product of $\mathbb{Z}_2$, and that this extension splits. We give a formula for Udall's section restricted to the pure mapping class group and, when $Γ$ has finitely many ends, on the whole mapping class group.
